app.name: Route Rush
board.label: City map. Move the van with arrow keys, swipes or taps.
play.title: Puzzle #{n} · {day}
play.hint: Tap a neighbouring tile, swipe, or use the arrow keys. Z = undo.
play.failed: Too late! An express parcel missed its deadline. Undo or restart.
play.warn: ⚠ Express deadline close: only {n} fuel to spare!
tutorial.done: You used {fuel} fuel (best: {best}). Ready for today's puzzle?
results.optimal: You matched the best possible score.
results.replay_note: Replay for fun: only your first run counts.
results.freeze_used: a streak freeze saved your streak
results.copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
results.route_done: Best route: {best} fuel. That's the 3-star score.
share.title: Route Rush #{n}
home.freezes_title: Streak freezes: each one protects one missed day
howto.1.title: Move the van
howto.1.text: Tap a neighbouring tile, swipe, or use the arrow keys. Roads cost 1 fuel, traffic jams cost 2. Buildings, parks and water are blocked.
howto.2.title: Deliver and reload
howto.2.text: Drive onto a house to drop off a parcel. When the van is empty, drive back to the depot to reload. Express houses ⚡ must be reached while your fuel is still above the number shown.
howto.3.title: Beat the target
howto.3.text: Your tank drains with every move. Deliver every parcel using as little fuel as possible: match the target for 3 stars. You don't have to return to the depot at the end.
stats.win_rate_note: Win rate = puzzles finished out of puzzles started.
stats.empty: Finish a puzzle to see your stats.

settings.reset_confirm: Delete your streak, stats, unlocks and saved runs? This can't be undone.
settings.about: Everything is saved on this device only. No account, no ads.
archive.intro: Replay the last 7 days. You get stars, but no streak.
archive.empty: Nothing to replay yet. Come back tomorrow!
play.nofuel: Out of fuel! Undo or restart.
career.hint.1: Welcome to Tiong Bahru! Deliver every parcel. When the van is empty, drive back to the depot to reload.
career.hint.2: New: traffic jams (orange) cost 2 fuel. A longer road can be cheaper.
career.hint.3: New: express houses ⚡ must be reached while your fuel is still at or above the number shown. Bridges are roads across the river.
career.hint.4: New: pickups. Visit the hawker stall first (the food takes a space in the van), then the house with the same colour and shape. No depot visit needed.
career.hint.5: New: one-way streets. A road tile with an arrow can only be entered moving in the arrow's direction.
career.hint.6: New: roadworks. The cone closes the road once your fuel falls to the number shown. Use it early, or go around.
career.boss_hint: Boss level! Every mechanic you have met so far is mixed together.
career.mech_desc.1: Roads, blocks, the depot and reloading.
career.mech_desc.3: Deadlines on express houses, and bridges over the river.
career.mech_desc.4: Collect food at a stall and bring it to the matching customer.
career.mech_desc.5: Arrows say which way you may enter a road.
career.mech_desc.6: Roads that close when your fuel runs low.
results.career_best: Your best on this level is {n} stars.
ach.rush_10.name: Rush 10
ach.rush_10.desc: Solve 10 puzzles in one Rush Hour run.
ach.rush_20.name: Rush 20
ach.rush_20.desc: Solve 20 puzzles in one Rush Hour run.
rush.intro: Solve as many small puzzles as you can in 3 minutes. Each new one appears straight away.
rush.rule_bonus: Solved: +1 point, +{a} s for the best fuel, +{b} s for 1 above it.
rush.rule_end: The run ends when the timer hits 0.
tip.reload: Your van is empty, but there are still parcels to deliver. Sometimes the van can't carry every parcel, so drive back to the depot to reload. The “In van” and “To deliver” counters always show how many parcels you carry and how many are left.
